The ability to perform oxygenic photosynthesis
A mechanism for rapid binary fission

Accumulation of toxic waste products and nutrient depletion
Formation of endospores by all bacteria
Increase in pH of the growth medium

stem: The relationship between humans and their normal bacterial flora, where both parties benefit, is best described as:
